glosses: A Scottish nickname usually applied to people with the first name Hew or Hugh or other spellings of this name.

examples.text: I'll be with you in a moment, shug.

glosses: To writhe the body so as to produce friction against one's clothes, as do those who have the itch.

examples.text: the Comtesse Leinsengen again shugged her shoulders , drew her shawl around her , and was preparing to depart
There I'll shug in and get a noble countenance.
